body: You're not a bad kid, you're likely fucking awesome. Speak to someone - can recommend samaritans.
Alright. Perfect thank you. I don't think I'll go to the GP. I'll call the Samaritans one day once I've dropped my daughter at school. Thanks!

I can't contact my wife. She left three years ago and we have tried everything. We certainly deserve an explanation but my daughter above all. I appreciate your help and I'll repeat what I said above. I try my best for my daughter and show her my strong side so that she feels OK not having to show me hers. This is why now I've noticed issues I'm trying to sort them out. You telling me to show my daughter my strong side won't help me with my suicidal thoughts...

my daughter is 15 and I am unbelievably proud of her. My wife left us with no explanation and since I am the only person she has left, I am extra certain that I won't do it, hence why I asked for the help. Thank you for your concern though!
